title: Lean Blog (Mark Graban) — 'The cultural work we do needs structural protection. Without it, every gain is one CFO away from being unwound.'
summary: Mark Graban — longtime lean-practitioner author of Measures of Success and host of My Favorite Mistake — publishes a written essay on Lean Blog reading Incorruptible through a lean-practitioner lens.
blockquote: The cultural work we do needs structural protection. Without it, every gain is one CFO away from being unwound.
